createButton.note: sidebar '새로운 게시물' link (a[role=link]) opens the '새 게시물 만들기' dialog directly, or on a professional account the createMenuPost menu (2026-10-04); only a visible one is pressed

createMenuPost.note: professional accounts: '새로운 게시물' opens a menu (게시물 · 라이브 방송 · 광고) instead of the dialog; its 게시물 item (a[role=link] with this svg) opens it (2026-10-04)

fileInput.note: searched only inside the create-post dialog (a profile-photo or message input elsewhere must never get the pictures); hidden multiple input behind '컴퓨터에서 선택', accept image/avif,image/jpeg,image/png,… (2026-10-04)

nextButton.note: the dialog's own 다음 (div[role=button]); the home page behind has story '다음' buttons too, so only the dialog is searched (2026-10-04)

caption.note: Lexical editor 'aria-label=캡션 추가...' on the last step, counter 'N/2200' (2026-10-04)

cropButton.note: several controls carry the label; the second (2026-10-04) opens the ratio menu (원본, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9)

cropOption.note: ratio menu items; their text starts with '원본', '1:1', '4:5', '16:9' (2026-10-04)

forbiddenClicks.note: never share the post: the user reviews and shares
professional accounts' create menu: never start a live video
professional accounts' create menu: never start an ad (English 'Ad' is too short to match safely; 게시물 is picked by its own icon)
any share control, also if '공유하기' is renamed
never discard a post: the user's work stays (rule 4), whatever word lists a remote file brings
